answer: A bond is refunded only after 18 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The inlet counter is kept in plume and walnut publishes each reset. An attacker hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 18 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4132 identities would post 3749 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
